packageRules.description: The @nestjs/* packages are released together and expect matching versions of each other. Splitting them across PRs produces a window where the tree is internally inconsistent, so they travel as one.
The OpenTelemetry packages have the same lockstep property, and their 0.x versioning means a minor bump is effectively a major.

Patch, pin and digest updates are automerged. They cannot change an API by definition, and CI - lint, type-check, unit tests, the coverage ratchet, e2e against real Postgres, and the Docker build - has to pass first; automerge waits on those checks.
Dev dependencies are automerged through minor as well. A broken linter or test runner fails CI loudly and immediately, and none of them reach production.
Major updates are never automerged, including for dev dependencies. This rule is last so it overrides the automerge rules above for any dependency they would otherwise have matched.
Node stays inside the engines range. 26 removed SlowBuffer, which breaks buffer-equal-constant-time under passport-jwt, so a Node major has to be a deliberate, tested decision rather than a bot PR.
